backtest.spread: Spreads, December-March: gap 3+ CLV +1.40, beat the close 71%, 57.6% ATS, +9.8% ROI (+11.6 / +7.2 / +10.4 by season, about 3 a day); gap 4+ CLV +2.03, 82%, 62.5%, +19.3% ROI (+22.9 / +11.1 / +22.1, about 1 a day)
backtest.total: Totals, December-March: gap 5+ CLV +2.42, beat the close 76%, 56.3% ATS, +7.5% ROI (+3.6 / +7.1 / +11.2, about 2 a day); gap 6+ +9.9% ROI
backtest.nov: November: favourites at a spread gap of 4+ (+7.7% ROI; CLV +1.32, but only +0.68 beyond the normal November drift toward favourites) and overs at a total gap of 5+ (+8.2% ROI, CLV +1.82) were the only cuts that made money, and both were chosen after seeing those same seasons; underdogs beat the close 45% of the time and unders lost every season
backtest.rlm: Reverse line movement (65%+ of tickets on one side, line moved 1+ the other way), graded at the closing number: 2023-25 51.4% and 2025-26 48.8% on spreads (needs 52.4%), totals about 50%. It can only pay at the number when the signal first fires, which history can't show, so the RLM tiers log that number live
backtest.caveat: ROI assumes -110 at the opener. DraftKings' first number equals Action's opener 89% of the time (Openers tab); FanDuel and BetMGM 40-48%, so bet the DK number when you can.
